assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a single polished macOS app icon for the Korean automatic Korean/English typing app "한녕".
Image 1 is the user's macOS input-source menu reference. Use only its restrained badge-with-one-letter visual language, not its text labels or the complete Hangul syllable 한.
Image 2 is a previously generated design the user finds FAR TOO SHINY. Preserve the idea of one recognizable Korean ㅎ centered inside an app tile, but completely replace the glass material and glowing treatment.
NEW DESIGN: a graphite-charcoal rounded-square macOS tile, matte fine-textured coated ceramic, dark neutral #30343A, no blue glow. A single ivory-white ㅎ in the center, crisp mature Hangul lettering. ㅎ must be the exact consonant: one short horizontal top cap, one longer horizontal bar below, then a circular ring below. NO ㄴ or additional glyphs. Use restrained semibold geometry, generous clean counter. The ㅎ is subtly raised porcelain, almost flat at its top surface with only a shallow bevel and a soft contact shadow showing about 1–2mm depth. The tile itself has gently curved edges and a shallow physical sidewall visible at lower edge. Soft diffuse daylight from upper left, broad low-contrast shading, quiet tactile finish. The icon should feel crafted and slightly dimensional but NOT glossy, reflective, wet, metallic, luminous, glittering, or neon. No specular streaks, glass, rim lighting or bloom. Not a flat vector logo pasted on a square either.
Front-on nearly orthographic composition, centered square tile with a generous transparent margin outside the tile. ONLY ONE app icon, no menu symbol, no text labels, no numbers, no watermarks, no desktop mockup. Transparent background, clean rounded corners. Serious utility software, never cute, no smile, no face, no mascot.
